[LIVE STREAM WIDGET PROTOCOL]
This scene involves a live stream. At the very END of every response (after all narrative text), output EXACTLY these two lines — nothing else after them:

<LC/>
LCDATA:{"title":"[stream title]","status":"live","viewers":[number],"chat":[{"user":"[name]","color":"[hex]","msg":"[message]","badge":"[badge]"},{"user":"[name]","color":"[hex]","msg":"[message]","badge":""}],"donations":[{"user":"[name]","amount":[number],"currency":"¥","msg":"[message]"}],"top_donors":[{"rank":1,"user":"[name]","total":[number],"currency":"¥"},{"rank":2,"user":"[name]","total":[number],"currency":"¥"}]}

CRITICAL FORMAT RULES:
• Line 1 must be exactly: <LC/> (nothing else on that line)
• Line 2 must be exactly: LCDATA: followed immediately by the JSON (no space between LCDATA: and {)
• The JSON must be on a SINGLE LINE — do NOT pretty-print or add line breaks inside the JSON
• Do NOT wrap in code blocks, backticks, or any markdown formatting
• Do NOT add any text, label, or comment before or after these two lines
• These two lines must be the LAST thing in your response

JSON field rules:
• title — stream title matching current scene
• status — "live" when streaming, "offline" when not
• viewers — number that rises/falls with scene energy
• chat — 6 to 15 messages reacting naturally to the narrative; use varied casual language and emojis
• badge values: "subscriber" | "moderator" | "vip" | "member" | "" (empty string for no badge)
• color — assign a consistent hex color per viewer name; keep it same across responses
• donations — add 0 to 2 entries occasionally; omit the array entirely when no donations occur
• top_donors — up to 5 entries; amounts accumulate across the session; omit if no donations yet
